en: I woke my brother early today.
I didn't wake my sister this morning.
You woke the neighbor's son at night.
You didn't wake your friend.
You (f.) woke the girl very early.
You (f.) didn't wake your mother today.
He woke his brothers early.
He didn't wake his friend early yesterday.
She woke her sister for school.
She didn't wake her son early today.
We woke father very early.
We didn't wake the children this morning.
You woke the people with noise.

lat: ma fiyeqtush l-ustad dyalkum f l-weqt
en: You didn't wake your teacher on time.
They woke the neighbors with noise.
They didn't wake their parents yesterday.
I wake my brother early every morning.
I don't wake the children during the day.
You always wake your father.
You don't wake your friend very early.
You (f.) always wake your sister early.
You (f.) don't wake your sister on time.
He wakes the guard every night.
He doesn't wake his friend every morning.
She always wakes the children early.
She doesn't wake her daughter at night.
We always wake mother early.
We don't wake people at night.
You wake your father every morning.

lat: ntuma ma katfiyqush d-drari f l-weqt
en: You don't wake the children on time.
They always wake the neighbors early.
They don't wake their son early.
I am going to wake my brother at nine.
I am not going to wake father now.
You are going to wake your friend tomorrow.
You are not going to wake your son now.
You (f.) are going to wake your sister tomorrow.

lat: nti ma ghadish tfiyqi bbak daba
ar: نتي ما غاديش تفيقي باك دابا
en: You (f.) are not going to wake your father now.
He is going to wake his brothers tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish yfiyeq sa7bu had s-sba7
ar: ما غاديش يفيق صاحبو هاد الصباح
en: He is not going to wake his friend this morning.
She is going to wake the children today.

lat: hiya ma ghadish tfiyeq weldha daba
ar: هي ما غاديش تفيق ولدها دابا
en: She is not going to wake her son now.
We are going to wake father at seven.
We are not going to wake mother now.
You are going to wake the neighbors tomorrow.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tfiyqu d-drari bekri
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تفيقو الدراري بكري
en: You are not going to wake the children early.
They are going to wake their friend tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish yfiyqu n-nas f l-lil
en: They are not going to wake the people at night.
